SITE: Taobao/Tmall. Go SLOWLY: wait 20 seconds (computer action wait, twice 10 s) before every navigation after the first. Maximum 4 page loads in total for this site.
1. Navigate to https://s.taobao.com/search?q=%E6%B0%AE%E5%8C%96%E9%95%93%E5%85%85%E7%94%B5%E5%99%A8%2065W . In javascript_tool build a list of cards: for each <a> whose href is item.taobao.com or detail.tmall.com, item id from the id= parameter, host, and the card innerText with newlines as |; store it in window.__tb and read it in chunks of 3. Do NOT return URLs.
2. Pick the 3 cards that best match the description; prefer different shops, include any official flagship (官方旗舰店).
3. For each of the 3 (wait 20 s before each): navigate to https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=<id> (it may redirect to tmall). Read shop name, shop rating, price, guarantees, variant names (颜色分类 etc.), any spec/parameter section and, if visible on the page, the review count and some reviews. Select the matching variant to read its price only if the price shown changes with the selection. If the page shows 访问异常 or any check, stop the site.
